oe_yw.29 = {
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_yw.29.t
    trigger = { has_variable = oe_yw_job }
    immediate = {
        if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_job = 21 } oe_yw_job_console = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_job = 41 } oe_yw_job_liang = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_yw_job = 71 } oe_yw_job_shazhou = yes }
        remove_variable = oe_yw_job
    }
}
